name: Pivot Table
summary: Lightweight pivot: nested, collapsible row groups × one column dimension with any aggregate, totals, CAGR, % of row / column and heat colouring.
summary_zh: 轻量数据透视表：可折叠的多级行分组 × 一个列维度，任意聚合函数，合计行 / 列、CAGR、行 / 列占比与热力着色。
description_zh: 把长表数据按 rows（外层→内层，可多级）和 cols 两个维度交叉汇总，value 用 sum / avg / median / count 等 RK 聚合函数计算；维度也可以是 RK 公式（如 year(date)）。采用紧凑布局：分组行直接显示小计并可折叠展开，底部合计行在滚动时固定，可加合计列和首末列 CAGR，也可切换为占行 / 列 / 总计百分比并用热力色突出结构。适合分部 × 地区 × 年份收入、按行业统计交易数量或中位倍数等结构分析，点击行标签或列头可交叉筛选其他图表。
best_for: Segment × region revenue by year with subtotals and CAGR
Deal counts or median multiples by sector × year / consideration
Mix analysis (% of column total) with heat colouring
avoid_when: More than ~12 columns (use a chart or data-grid)
A single flat list (use comps-table or data-grid)

rows.desc: options.rows — row dimensions, outer to inner (fields or RK formulas)

cols.desc: options.cols — column dimension (field or RK formula, e.g. year(date))

value.desc: options.value — measure field or row formula (omit with agg 'count' to count rows)

rows.desc: Row dimensions, outer to inner (fields or RK formulas)

cols.desc: Column dimension (field or RK formula); null = a single value column

value.desc: Measure field or row formula; null with agg 'count' counts rows

agg.desc: sum | avg | median | min | max | count | countd | stdev | first | last (RK.expr aggregates)

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the measure format; '#,##0' for counts)

totalRow.desc: Totals row at the bottom (sticky while scrolling)

cagr.desc: CAGR column from the first to the last column (assumes evenly spaced periods)

collapsible.desc: Chevrons to collapse / expand outer row groups

collapsed.desc: Start with outer row groups collapsed

sort.desc: null (data order) | 'label' | 'total-desc' | 'total-asc' — applied at every level

colSort.desc: asc | desc | null (data order) for the column dimension

valueTitle.desc: Measure label in the header corner (defaults to e.g. 'Median EV/LTM EBITDA' or 'Number of records')

scroll.desc: true: fixed block height with sticky header, label column and totals; false: grow to content

tooltip.desc: Hover tooltip with value, shares and record count

crossFilter.desc: Click a row label or column header to cross-filter (plain-field dimensions only)

interactions: Hover tooltip with % of column / row and record count
Click a row label or column header to cross-filter
Sticky header, label column and totals row
